text:
Hi there, and thanks for contacting Leafy! 🌿

I'm sorry, but I can't change an account email over chat. This is a security measure to keep your account safe. The good news is that you can update it yourself in just a few steps once you're logged in:

- Log in to your Leafy account on the website or app.
- Go to "Account" and update the email address there.

If you run into trouble logging in, or you think someone else may have accessed your account, please reset your password right away and let me know. I'll escalate it to a Support Lead so it gets looked at properly.

Is there anything else I can help you with today? Happy to help anytime! 🌱
